Abhi yeh sahi nahi hai. Dono ne do-do hisse khaye; ab bas dono ke ek-ek hisse ka size milao. Farhan ne chocolate ka 2/7 khaya aur Isha ne 2/3, toh zyada kisne khaya?
director.card: Toh zyada kisne khaya, Farhan ne ya Isha ne?

director.text: Isha, 2/3

Sahi jawab. Dekho, dono ne 2 hisse khaye, par Isha ke 1/3 wale hisse Farhan ke 1/7 wale hisson se bade the. Toh poora jawab: Isha ne, 2/3. Teen ek jaisi chocolate hain: ek ka 4/5 liya, ek ka 4/9, aur ek ka 4/7. In teeno ko chhote se bade tak order mein lagao.

director.text: 4/9, phir 4/7, phir 4/5

Haan, sahi hai: teeno mein 4 hisse, par 1/9 ka hissa sabse chhota aur 1/5 ka sabse bada; isliye 4/9, phir 4/7, phir 4/5. Anjali aur Imran ke paas ek jaise ribbon hain. Anjali apna ribbon 12 barabar hisson mein kaatkar 5 leti hai, aur Imran apna ribbon 6 mein kaatkar 5 leta hai. Dono apne liye hue hisse jodkar ek ribbon banate hain. Kiska ribbon lamba banega, Anjali ka ya Imran ka?

director.text: Anjali

Nahi, yeh theek nahi hai. Dono ne paanch-paanch liye; ab socho ki 6 mein kate ribbon ka ek hissa bada hai ya 12 mein kate ka. Anjali ke paas ribbon ka 5/12 hai aur Imran ke paas 5/6, toh kiska ribbon lamba hai?

director.text: Imran ka ribbon

Bilkul sahi, kyunki dono ke paanch-paanch hisse, par Imran ka har hissa Anjali ke hisse ka do guna hai. Do pizza hain, bilkul ek jaise. Ek ke 7 barabar hisson mein se 6 bache, doosre ke 9 mein se 8. Dono mein poore pizza se bas ek-ek hissa kam hai. Poore pizza ke zyada paas kaun hai, 6/7 ya 8/9?
director.card: Do pizza hain, bilkul ek jaise. Ek ke 7 barabar hisson mein se 6 bache, doosre ke 9 mein se 8. Dono mein poore pizza se bas ek-ek hissa kam hai. Poore pizza ke zyada paas kaun hai, 6/7 ya 8/9?

director.text: 8/9 hai na

Haan, bilkul theek, kyunki 8/9 mein bas 1/9 ki kami hai, 6/7 mein 1/7 ki, aur 1/9 ki kami chhoti hai. Ab poore paath ko yaad karke bas ek sawaal aur karna hai. Do ek jaisi patti hain: ek ke 10 barabar hisson mein se 7 liye, doosri ke 12 mein se 7. Kaunsa chhota hai, 7/10 ya 7/12?

12/7 sahi nahi hai. Dono mein 7 hisse liye gaye; ab dekho kis patti ka ek hissa chhota hai. Do ek jaisi patti hain: ek ke 10 barabar hisson mein se 7 liye, doosri ke 12 mein se 7. Kaunsa chhota hai, 7/10 ya 7/12?
12/7 nahi, yeh jawab theek nahi baitha. Iska jawab hai 7/12, kyunki dono se 7 hisse liye, par 12 hisson wali patti ka har hissa chhota hai, isliye 7/12 chhota hai. Ab tak samajh aaya?
shayad gin ke

Har paath mein kuch naya hota hai. Aaj dekha ki ek hi poore ke jitne zyada barabar hisse hon, har hissa utna chhota hota hai. Phir dekha: neeche wala number same ho toh hisse ek size ke, aur hisson ki ginti faisla karti hai. Aakhir mein dekha: hisson ki ginti same ho, toh jiske hisse bade, wahi fraction zyada hota hai. Aaj ka kaam aasaan laga ya thoda mushkil?
thoda mushkil, thoda aasaan
Aaj humne milkar kaafi kuch dekha. Aaj ke paath mein tumne dekha ki 6/7 aur 8/9 mein kiski kami chhoti hai. Aaj ke liye itna hi, phir milenge!
